advisories.title: The draft's COORDINATOR-DECISIONS digest necessarily differs from the contract's own remeasured pin, and the draft does not say why
advisories.detail: The draft measures 39f372e1... (live, HEAD 8fdd59c). The frozen contract's reMeasurementAtV2 records b9819d6e... at HEAD 36949e3. A reader comparing the draft's table to the contract's pins sees two different digests for the same path with no stated reconciliation. The whole difference is C-D106, appended after v2 authoring.
advisories.whyOnlyAdvisory: The draft measures the file as its own input at draft time; it makes no claim that its value equals the contract's pin, so nothing false is recorded and no MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX arises. I verified independently that C-D106 disturbs none of the three properties the contract named (D-002, D-015, D-056), so the recording is sound on the merits, not merely unfalsified.
advisories.suggestedFix: One clause at adoption: 'COORD moved from b9819d6e... (D-105 HEAD) to 39f372e1... via C-D106; the contract's three named properties D-002 / D-015 / D-056 are re-checked and undisturbed.'

advisories.title: 'Lock production remains deferred to DR-111' names one of the two gates the DR-111 contract states
advisories.detail: compatibility-matrices-contract.v5 conditions lock production on DR-111 closing with evaluable windows AND a later DR-103 successor that consumes those windows. The draft names only the DR-111 limb. The DR-107 contract separately routes the concrete lock schema / solver encoding to DR-103 lockSchema plus this row's mechanismReservation (ID-DEP-G1), while DR-111 owns window meaning (ID-DEP-G3).
advisories.whyOnlyAdvisory: The sentence is true as written — production is in fact deferred to DR-111, among others — and its operative content, that no lock is producible now, is preserved and reinforced by the adjacent 'Concrete journal/lock/lease encoding remains reserved'. Adopted D-106 uses the same one-limb phrasing. A reader routing future work off this sentence alone would under-name a co-owner, not act on a falsehood.
advisories.whyThisIsNotGradedAsIWouldGradeAMisroute: I would raise a SHOULD-FIX where a decision assigns an obligation to the wrong row, because a coordinator would then route work to a row that cannot discharge it. Here no obligation is assigned away: DR-111 genuinely holds one gate, and the draft's reservation clause keeps DR-107's own half visible. The gap is completeness, not misdirection.
advisories.suggestedFix: At adoption, prefer the corpus-standard 'No lock is producible.' (D-103 / D-104 / D-105) alongside the DR-111 deferral, or name both limbs: 'Lock production remains deferred to DR-111 closing and a later DR-103 successor.'

authorityOfThisVerdict.whatConsentMeansHere: CONSENT is a statement about THIS DRAFT ONLY: at turn 1 of 3, zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX survive my adversarial measurement, so the draft is fit to proceed in the D-000 cycle. It does not adopt D-107, does not mark DR-107 SATISFIED, does not move the register row off PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW, seals nothing, and authorizes nothing under docs/v2/implementation/.

coordinatorNote: The draft is disciplined in exactly the places this cycle has been burned before. It carries the D-106 turn-1 correction forward by naming the register path three times and explicitly refusing the coop/architecture substitution; it carries the turn-2 correction forward by citing only digests that reproduce, all five of them, both verdicts frozen at 0444. Its denials are not boilerplate: each one I traced (D-056 Class A, DR-G18, DR-110, the mechanism reservation, DR-111) is supported by the governing text rather than merely asserted, and the D-056 refusal is right for the right reason — DR-G18 is unauthored, so the remainder is not execution-only and the gate is unmet on its own terms. Where the draft departs from D-106's wording it departs toward accuracy: it drops 'SATISFIED-GRADE', which would have overstated two ordinary independent-review verdicts, and it names DR-107's true register token instead of a bare 'OPEN'. The strongest attack available was that C-D106 moved the COORDINATOR-DECISIONS pin the frozen contract inherited; I ran it to ground and all three named properties survive D-106 untouched, so the recording rests on live evidence rather than on a stale bound. Two advisories travel as honesty work and neither is a gate. 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX: CONSENT.
